name: connect-rust (connectrpc)
description: Tower-based ConnectRPC implementation for Rust, serving gRPC over HTTP/2 (connectrpc crate)

upstream_pin.notes: crates.io max stable at pin time; serves gRPC over HTTP/2 per upstream README; harness builds with --locked

server.description: SB-18 connectrpc interop server (tests/interop/connect; followup, not yet in tree)

transport_contract.mechanism: connectrpc grpc-over-h2 server on hyper: 16 MiB windows, 1 MiB frames, 256 streams, TCP_NODELAY on; getsockopt-verified like NodelayIncoming

client.reason: No open-loop client driver for connect-rust; optional client cells are not_run. Server cells use the native generator.

tls.plan: Harness serves the in-tree PEM test PKI (--tls-cert/--tls-key) with the suite restricted to TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256; the native generator verifies with ca.crt and server name localhost.
